--- a/backend/services/contact_manager.py
+++ b/backend/services/contact_manager.py
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
+from typing import Optional
 from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
 from backend.data.models import Contact
 from backend.services.memory_extractor import extract_contact_facts_from_memory
@@ -10,7 +11,7 @@ def _extract_contact_updates_from_memory_payload(memory: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]
     return {}
 
 
-def _should_auto_apply_contact_memory_update(memory: Any, target_contact: Any) -> bool:
+def _should_auto_apply_contact_memory_update(memory: Any, target_contact: Any) -> bool:
     """Return True if the memory payload contains confirmed facts for an already matched existing contact."""
     updates = _extract_contact_updates_from_memory_payload(memory)
     if not updates:
@@ -18,7 +19,7 @@ def _should_auto_apply_contact_memory_update(memory: Any, target_contact: Any) -
     # Check if the extracted updates match the target contact's known fields
     for key, value in updates.items():
         if hasattr(target_contact, key) and getattr(target_contact, key) is not None:
-            if getattr(target_contact, key) != value:
+            if getattr(target_contact, key) != value:
                 # Confirmed fact differs from existing value -> do not auto-apply
                 return False
     # All extracted updates match or are new -> auto-apply
@@ -26,7 +27,7 @@ def _should_auto_apply_contact_memory_update(memory: Any, target_contact: Any) -
 
 
 def _apply_contact_memory_update_directly(db_session: Session, *, target_contact: Any, proposal_payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
-    """Apply confirmed contact facts directly to the target contact record."""
+    """Apply confirmed contact facts directly to the target contact record and persist."""
     for key, value in proposal_payload.items():
         if hasattr(target_contact, key):
             setattr(target_contact, key, value)
@@ -35,7 +36,7 @@ def _apply_contact_memory_update_directly(db_session: Session, *, target_contac
     return {"status": "applied", "contact_id": target_contact.id, "updates": proposal_payload}
 
 
-def stage_contact_update_from_memory(db_session: Session, *, memory: Any, chat_id: Optional[int] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+def stage_contact_update_from_memory(db_session: Session, *, memory: Any, chat_id: Optional[int] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
     """Stage or apply confirmed contact facts from memory to an existing contact."""
     # Extract contact facts from memory
     proposal_payload = _extract_contact_updates_from_memory_payload(memory)
@@ -43,7 +44,7 @@ def stage_contact_update_from_memory(db_session: Session, *, memory: Any, chat
         return {"status": "no_updates", "contact_id": None}
 
     # Find the existing contact by chat_id or other means
-    target_contact = db_session.query(Contact).filter(Contact.chat_id == chat_id).first()
+    target_contact = db_session.query(Contact).filter(Contact.chat_id == chat_id).first() if chat_id else None
     if not target_contact:
         return {"status": "no_existing_contact", "contact_id": None}
 
@@ -52,7 +53,7 @@ def stage_contact_update_from_memory(db_session: Session, *, memory: Any, chat
         return _apply_contact_memory_update_directly(db_session, target_contact=target_contact, proposal_payload=proposal_payload)
 
     # Otherwise, return as proposal for manual review
-    return {"status": "proposal", "contact_id": target_contact.id, "proposal_payload": proposal_payload}
+    return {"status": "proposal", "contact_id": target_contact.id, "proposal_payload": proposal_payload}
 
 
 # End of patch for BACKLOG-108
